summary: Initializes four consecutive DWORD/float fields on a __thiscall object to default values: offset 0x0 to 0 (0.0f), 0x4 to 1101004800 (20.0f), 0x8 to 1050253722 (0.3f), and 0xC to 0 (0.0f). Returns the object pointer (this). No guards, globals or callees; unconditional four-field initialization.

operations.description: Set this+0x4 to literal 1101004800, the IEEE-754 bit pattern of 20.0f.
Set this+0x8 to literal 1050253722, the IEEE-754 bit pattern of 0.3f.
Return the original this pointer, making the result the freshly-initialized object.

unresolved: The owning class of this four-float configuration object is unknown; only the per-field defaults are evidenced.
The semantic meaning of the 20.0f and 0.3f defaults (a range/proportion pair on a per-object basis) depends on the unknown owner.
Callers sub_4FCC30, sub_4FD8B0 and sub_4FE350 are known but their role in invoking this initializer is not analyzed here.
